name: Untrusted selected context is labeled before Codex use
decision: Codex-facing briefs should label untrusted or external selected context with deterministic warnings and proof boundaries instead of treating selected context as trusted execution truth.
falsifier: A future Codex brief renders untrusted external source or memory text without a warning label or proof boundary and adapter tests still pass.
doesNotProve: This card does not prove prompt-injection resistance, safe Codex execution, source truth, or product readiness.
